test_cygrpc_server_lifecycle: test the cygrpc Server by creating, starting, and shutting down a gRPC server with completion queues
create_cygrpc_completion_queue: create a cygrpc CompletionQueue to handle server call and shutdown events
run_cygrpc_server_http2_port: run a cygrpc Server that adds an HTTP/2 port and starts accepting calls
test_cygrpc_server_request_call: test the cygrpc Server request_call method to register a call with a completion queue and tag
test_cygrpc_server_shutdown: test the cygrpc Server shutdown method to gracefully stop the server and poll for completion
